title: private deployment - orion weekly sync 2026-07-20
summary: Weekly sync notes for Orion private deployment. Focus on VPC peering, on-prem infra readiness, and next milestones. Contains blockers and owners.
content:
Weekly sync - Orion private deployment
Date: 2026-07-20
Owner: Asha Patel
Attendees: Samantha Reyes (Orion - IT), Diego Martinez (Orion - Platform), Evan Chen (Redwood eng-private-deployments), Lina Gomez (Redwood solutions), Marcus Li (SRE)

Agenda:
- Quick status roundtrip
- VPC/networking: peering, routes, NAT
- On-prem infra: k8s nodes, GPU sizing, storage
- Security & certs: KMS/HSM integration
- Rollout plan & cutover windows
- Blockers and action items

Notes:
- Networking: Customer completed VPC peering in dev account; staging peering still pending. Diego to confirm route propagation and that there are no overlapping CIDRs. (BLOCKER)
- VPN vs Direct Connect: decided to prefer AWS Direct Connect for production to avoid jitter; cost approval pending from Orion finance.
- On-prem infra: Orion confirmed 6x A10G nodes for initial cluster. Need to validate driver/kernel (NVIDIA 525+) and CUDA. Evan to run a quick smoke test image next week.
- Storage: using NFS for model artifacts is acceptable for now; long-term will move to S3-compatible object store behind gateway.
- KMS: Orion security prefers customer-managed KMS. Lina to draft step-by-step for key rotation and IAM roles.
- Rollout: Canary plan approved: 10% traffic routed to private for 48h then 50% for 24h before full cut.

Milestones (high level):
- 2026-07-23: Staging VPC peering + route validation (owner: Diego)
- 2026-07-27: Smoke tests on GPU nodes + driver validation (owner: Evan)
- 2026-07-30: KMS integration test + key rotation dry-run (owner: Lina)
- 2026-08-03: Canary config and traffic routing ready (owner: Asha)

Blockers & Risks:
- B1: Staging VPC peering not completed -> blocks staging end-to-end tests. (Owner: Diego) Status: pending action from Orion networking team.
- B2: Direct Connect cost approval delayed -> may force VPN fallback with higher latency. (Owner: Samantha) Status: finance review.
- B3: GPU driver kernel mismatch observed on one node during initial bootstrap. (Owner: Evan) Status: investigating; may push milestone by 2-3 days.
- Risk: S3 access patterns for model download could cause burst IOPS; plan to add caching layer on inference nodes.

Action items:
- Diego: Confirm route propagation and post screenshots of route tables for staging by 2026-07-22. (ASAP)
- Samantha: Follow up with finance on Direct Connect approval and provide expected approval timeline by 2026-07-22.
- Evan: Run smoke test image on all 6 GPU nodes, collect nvml/drivers output, and open any infra tickets by 2026-07-27.
- Lina: Draft KMS integration runbook and share with Orion security for review by 2026-07-29.
- Asha: Prepare canary routing config and rollback playbook; share infra config in repo PR by 2026-08-01. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orion-deployments/pull/42)

Decisions:
- Use Direct Connect for production (pending finance); fallback VPN for testing.
- Start with NFS for model artifacts; evaluate object-store gateway for production.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Diego to confirm if there are any corporate proxy requirements for outbound egress to model registry.
- Samantha to confirm SOC2 checklist items related to key management.

Next sync: 2026-07-27, same time. Agenda: staging test results, GPU smoke test findings, KMS dry-run status.

Notes to self (quick): capture kernel logs from node-03, ask infra to snapshot before driver change, test with smaller model to validate latency baseline.

Links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/ORION/Private+Deployment+Onboarding
- Jira: JIRA-ORION-512 (staging peering), JIRA-ORION-523 (driver mismatch)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orion-deployments/pull/42
